The '''Hutta Orbital Station''', or '''Hutta Space Station''', was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that orbited the planet [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. It was the only official way to reach the planet's surface as an Imperial citizen, as visitors to the world were required to dock at the station and take a shuttle down to the [[Jiguuna Spaceport]].
